categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses access to veterinary care through multiple mechanisms including expedited licensure for veterinarians, clarification of prescription and compounded drug use, and a drug donation program. bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.

categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Animal abuse; animal neglect; classification
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses animal abuse and neglect classification, which directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals who frequently identify, document, and report suspected abuse or neglect cases in clinical settings. bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses alternative pathways for veterinary technician education and establishes certification requirements for the profession. It directly impacts how veterinary technicians can qualify and become certified to practice.

bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a statewide spay and neuter assistance program and fund, which would increase demand for spay and neuter surgical procedures performed in veterinary clinics. bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary licensing permits for regulated professions, which could apply to veterinary paraprofessionals who need to practice before obtaining full licensure or credentials. bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses, which could enable veterinary paraprofessionals to work in their field while completing full licensure requirements or during credential transitions.
